annotations.title: Tokenized Real-World Assets — What the Advisor of Record Actually Needs to Know

description: How to discuss tokenized Treasuries, money-market funds and other on-chain-wrapped assets with a client without conflating them with speculative crypto: due-diligence questions (structural model, redemption cap, custodian concentration), suitability framing around liquidity mismatch, and the state of SEC guidance as of January 2026. Written from the advisor's practice and compliance perspective.
name: rwa.deep_dive_track
